newsitem.title: USA: DavCo unit says signs Friendly's agreement.
newsitem.headline: DavCo unit says signs Friendly's agreement.

text.p: DavCo Restaurants Inc said on Monday its subsidiary FriendCo Restaurants Inc signed agreements with Friendly's Restaurants Franchise Inc and Friendly Ice Cream Corp for the purchase of restaurants.

In a press release, DavCo said FriendCo will purchase certain assets and rights to 34 existing Friendly's Restaurants and will manage under contract with an option to purchase 14 other Friendly's locations in the area.
FriendCo will also have exclusive rights to develop and operate Friendly's Restaurants in Maryland, northern Virginia, Delaware and the District of Columbia.
In addition, FriendCo will have the rights to open up to an additional 100 Friendly's Restaurants during a 10 year period with a commitment to construct 74 new restaurants in the first six years.
The effective date will be the start of business on July 14.
The company did not disclose the financial terms of the agreement.

DavCo Restaurants currently franchises Wendy's International Inc restaurants and operates 229 restaurants in Maryland, northern Virginia, the District of Columbia, metropolitan St. Louis, central Illinois and Nashville, Tenn.
